area.hero.h1: Heating and cooling repair in Lakeview, Chicago
area.hero.lede: Boilers and radiators, furnaces, central air and ductless systems, for Lakeview two- and three-flats, courtyard condos, lakefront high-rises and the restaurants on Clark and Halsted. Family-owned since 1952, with the owner, Rob, still on the calls.

area.who.copy: City & Suburban is run from 1225 N Cleaver St, 1.9 miles south of Lakeview's edge at Diversey. Rob, the owner, still runs the calls and does the diagnosis on the jobs that need it.
area.reviews.1.quote: City & Suburban has serviced our HVAC system twice, over 5 years apart. Each experience was positive. They addressed our needs, answered our questions, and didn't try to upsell us. Both techs were very friendly and knowledgeable. Today, Eddie showed up when expected and fixed our AC within 45 minutes. If you call the office, you may not get an answer if they're busy.
area.reviews.2.quote: Super responsive, knowledgeable and friendly with very fair prices and quality work. Have used them the last 2 years to recharge my AC refrigerant and never got up sold. AC went out again this week, called for an appointment on Tuesday and was able to get one same day. Needed a new AC unit this time, and could have gotten it installed as early as the next day.
area.reviews.3.quote: When another company purported that I needed to replace my central air conditioning unit, I called Rob from City and Suburban for a second opinion. He quickly diagnosed the problem as a minor leak that could be repaired quickly, and he restored the unit to life at a fraction of the cost that I would have otherwise paid. The air conditioner continued to operate for years, by the way.
area.reviews.4.quote: My furnace went out, so I contacted City and Suburban Heating and Cooling to set up an appointment to get it checked out. Rob, the service tech, showed up on time to help me out. He told me he had to change out one part to get it up and running again, which he did in a very timely manner. And, without breaking the bank.
area.scope.heading: The same repair costs differently in a two-flat, a courtyard condo and a tower
area.scope.1.why: Many two-flats and courtyard buildings still heat with a boiler and radiators. A boiler repair is a different job from a furnace one.
area.scope.2.why: In courtyard buildings one central boiler heats every unit, so repairs go through the board or management.
area.scope.3.why: Fan coils on a building loop, with management approval, a certificate of insurance and booked elevator time.
area.scope.4.why: Radiator-heated flats have no ducts for central air, so cooling usually means ductless mini-splits.
area.scope.5.why: Kitchen exhaust and make-up air on Clark, Halsted and Broadway, scheduled around opening hours.
area.scope.6.why: The biggest swing of all. Where the unit has years left, we say so.

area.faq.heading: Lakeview HVAC, answered
area.faq.1.q: Does the boiler in my two-flat need replacing, or can it be repaired?
area.faq.1.a: Often it can be repaired. We diagnose first, and where the boiler has years left, we say so. Replacement is quoted only when the repair stops making sense.
area.faq.2.q: Do you work in Lakeview high-rises?
area.faq.3.q: Who decides on the boiler in a courtyard condo building?
area.faq.4.q: Does HVAC repair in Chicago need a permit?
area.cta.body: Have the make of your boiler, furnace or condenser to hand, and tell us what it's doing. In a high-rise, mention your building's work hours and elevator booking.

extras.faq.2.a: Yes. High-rises usually want a certificate of insurance, booked elevator time and set working hours, so we book around your building. In-unit fan coils on a building loop are common there.
extras.faq.3.a: The association usually does. One central boiler heats every unit, so repairs go through the board or management. We diagnose first and explain the options.
extras.faq.4.a: No. Chicago doesn't require a permit to repair, diagnose or maintain heating and cooling. Permits cover installs and construction, so a company's permit count says little about its repair work.
